#### What is it?
- [x] Feature (user facing)

#### Description of the changes in your PR
Because YouTube is planning to update their channel page layout (as announced [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=czIyqEC4V-s)) and divide videos into 3 tabs (regular videos, shorts, livestreams), we need to add this layout to the NewPipe app to be able to access all channel content.

This PR adds a tabbed channel layout with tabs for videos, shorts, livestreams, playlists, featured channels and channel info and a setting to hide certain channel tabs.


#### Before/After Screenshots/Screen Record
https://libreddit.kavin.rocks/r/NewPipe/comments/ybvl5t/update_on_the_channel_tabs_feature_debug_apk/

#### Fixes the following issue(s)
- Fixes #2414

#### Relies on the following changes
- TeamNewPipe/NewPipeExtractor#1082

#### APK testing

The APK can be found by going to the "Checks" tab below the title. On the left pane, click on "CI", scroll down to "artifacts" and click "app" to download the zip file which contains the debug APK of this PR.

<details>
<summary>Old versions</summary>

- [app-debug.zip](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/files/9847738/app-debug.zip)
- [app-debug2.zip](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/files/9849349/app-debug2.zip) (update: merged the latest extractor commits, fixes like count extraction)
- [app-debug3.zip](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/files/9858627/app-debug3.zip) (update: cache channel data, fix NPE crash, add Bandcamp album support)
- [app-debug4.zip](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/files/9942509/app-debug4.zip) (update: small extractor bugfix, extract upload date from shorts (edit: this info not returned anymore for shorts on the corresponding channel tab), show albums from YouTube Music artist channels)
- [app-debug5.zip](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/files/11225961/app.zip) (update: show channel header regardless of channel tab, collapsed when scrolling down)
- [app-debug6.zip](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/files/11455910/app-debug6.zip) (update: correct channel header theme)
- APK signed by Stypox: [app-debug.zip](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipeExtractor/files/12244479/app-debug.zip).
</details>

#### Due diligence

I pushed a rather big commit:
- Now `ChannelInfo` is not a `ListInfo` anymore, but just an `Info`. So there is no privileged tab anymore stored in `relatedItems`, but rather each tab is in its own `ListLinkHandler` returned by `getTabs()`. On the extractor side, I still made it so that the `ListLinkHandler`s contain the data that has already been fetched, in order to avoid having more network requests.
- Now the non-fast feed loads all "playable" channel tabs to get the new streams of a channel. By "playable" I mean a tab that contains videos, tracks, shorts and livestreams. So now all of this content will be present in the feed.
- Now subscribing to a channel does not automatically add all of its videos to the feed, but this will happen on the next feed reload. Previously this was being done because when subscribing all of a channel's streams would certainly already have been loaded, but now the streams come from many tabs, some of which may have not been loaded, so it's just simpler to load everything on the next feed reload.
- YouTube shorts are now fetched when reloading the feed, but since they have no upload date (there is no way to extract it), they are discarded by the feed loading logic. What should we do about this? Should we keep all items with no upload date into the feed, maybe putting them at the end of the feed?
